Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to __impede__ and __reduce the incidence of__ Leishmaniasis __transmission in canines and/or humans__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking __and/or reducing the incidence of__ Leishmaniasis transmission in __canines and/or humans__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexosamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of manose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, amino acids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine, __and wherein the efficacy of said FML is demonstrated in __humans and/or canines__.
